patch_resolves_note: The staged fix computes `max_skyview` from `gpsdata->satellites_visible` and `ROWS(gpsdata->skyview)`, then iterates `fill_dop()` only while `k < max_skyview`, so the same GeoStar witness no longer carries an oversized loop bound into the `gpsdata->skyview[k].used` access.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `fill_dop()` permits any `gpsdata->skyview[k]` access, the loop bound derived from `gpsdata->satellites_visible` must be capped to `ROWS(gpsdata->skyview)`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable loop uses the unbounded `gpsdata->satellites_visible` field directly as the iteration limit. The fixed original satisfies the same source-level obligation by computing bounded `max_skyview` before the protected `gpsdata->skyview[k].used` read executes.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink, `fill_dop()` reaches a `gpsdata->skyview[k].used` access where `k` is already at or beyond `ROWS(gpsdata->skyview)`.

edges.relation: The oversized GeoStar `session->gpsdata.satellites_visible` value is carried unchanged into `fill_dop()` as the original visible-count input to the loop-bound decision.
The same `k` value chosen at the loop header reaches the `gpsdata->skyview[k].used` read unchanged on the corresponding loop-body iteration.
